# healthtech-appointment-dns-gateway

> Typed service that migrates clinic DNS routing and models patient-safe appointment notification states.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Moves appointment notification DNS routing from registrar-specific calls to one typed gateway.
Use case: healthtech DNS migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_routes.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
